shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '*spec.md' -g '*spec*' -g 'package.json' -g '*.test.*' -g '.lore/dod.md' -g '.lore/test-commands.yml' | head -200 && git status --short --branch && cat .lore/dod.md && cat .lore/test-commands.yml"

/bin/zsh -lc "cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && cat src/types/ai.ts && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/orchestratorHelpers.test.ts && cat package.json && sed -n '1,100p' specs/hal-engine-tool-responses/spec.md && rg -n 'specs/|validated by|spec anchor|specAnchor|spec:' src scripts .lore"
/bin/zsh -lc "cat jest.config.js && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && cat specs/hal-engine-thinking-tag-parser/spec.md | head -80 && git branch -vv && git remote -v"

/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short && nl -ba specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git diff --no-index /dev/null .lore/dod.md || true'

/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "test(tools): define input validation contract" && git push origin HEAD'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch && git status -sb && git rev-parse HEAD && git rev-parse @{u} && git log -1 --oneline'
